posts.text: BREAKING: Global central bank gold purchases rose +62 tonnes YoY in Q2 2026, to 289 tonnes, the biggest quarterly addition since Q4 2024. Quarter-over-quarter, gold purchases surged +231 tonnes, or +407%. Year-to-date, central banks have acquired +345 tonnes of gold. Poland has led these purchases at +82 tonnes, bringing its total reserves to a record 632 tonnes. Uzbekistan and China followed, adding +41 tonnes and +40 tonnes, respectively, so far this year. Central banks continue to accumulate gold at a rapid pace.
